text:
You need historical commercial real estate capital values and yearly growth figures for retail, office, and industrial markets back to 1990.

I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. I’ve built data work that turns raw information into decision-ready outputs. For Riverbend Education Fund, I cleaned and weighted a 4,200-response parent survey and wrote the findings for the board, with 3 findings adopted in the next funding plan.

I can help structure, clean, and analyze commercial property value data into a clear year-by-year view similar to RP Data-style growth tracking. If needed, I can also build a simple dashboard or spreadsheet model to make the trends easy to compare across sectors.

Do you already have a preferred data source, or would you like help identifying one?
